message.reasoning_content:

The finance-summaries.net claims $416.2B revenue, $112.0B net income, EPS $7.46 — that's wrong (looks fabricated/hallucinated). Let me fetch the Apple newsroom page and SEC filing to verify.

Also note Q4 FY2024 revenue $94.9B, up 6%. But that snippet also could be wrong — actually Apple's Q4 FY2024 revenue was $94.93 billion, up 6%. That's correct. Net income Q4 FY2024 was $14.74 billion, EPS $0.97.
